t: # Short Obligatory Prayer ## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon. Hlaa, weiyat suus uu dii dung Tl'aahlaany; eihl uu saa dungeng dii guudengaan. Uhl giisluu wy'laat tlii dii xaagaas k'an uu, is siis dii k'ungisgdygaas k'ang tlii dung iitlaa gadaas. Dung squun nuueitl dung klaaiidunggung. Dung kil Eihl ging gets sqwaagu saang.
